ABOUT_ME.MY_SKILLS_DESC: I have a strong foundation in object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns. I'm experienced with Java, C#, and Python, and I write clean, testable code using unit and mock testing. On the web side, I work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and ASP. My database skills include PL/SQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and Firebase. I'm also familiar with modern frameworks like React, Flask, Java Spring, Bootstrap, and jQuery.
ABOUT_ME.TITLE_INTRO_DESC: My name is Danil Moskalenko. I am a Full Stack Web Developper and amateur Photographer living in Montréal, Canada. I’ve got a thing for both tech and photography. I love exploring new ideas, learning as I go, and finding that perfect mix of creativity and problem-solving. Whether I'm working on a project or just out with my camera, I'm always up for trying something new and challenging myself.

APPLICATIONS.GROCERY_APP_DESC: A personal-use grocery app with a simple, intuitive design and focused functionality. Built with React, vanilla CSS, and Firestore. It supports creating and removing custom food categories, adding multiple items at once, and marking items as purchased or deleted. Designed for quick, straight to the point list management.
